A name appears here only once it has TRIGGERED the validated MACD-2D × StochRSI-3D confluence buy (engine/signal_gate): the 2D MACD and 3D StochRSI have crossed within the last ~6 days and momentum is still constructive (Buy zone), OR the 3D StochRSI has crossed and the 2D MACD is about to cross in the next 1-2 bars (About to cross). McClellan Oscillator麦克莱伦振荡指标 ?Ratio-adjusted McClellan Oscillator: the 19-day minus 39-day EMA of net advances (normalised so a changing universe size doesn't distort it). Above zero & rising = breadth momentum building; below zero & falling = internals rolling over. The Summation Index is its running total — its slope and sign carry the meaning, not the absolute (cumulative) level.比率调整后的麦克莱伦振荡指标：净上涨家数的19日与39日指数均线之差（已归一化，避免样本规模变化造成失真）。高于零且上行 = 广度动量在累积；低于零且下行 = 内部结构在回落。累积指标是其累计和 — 关键在斜率与正负号，而非绝对（累计）水平。

Breadth Thrust (Zweig)广度脉冲（兹威格） ?The 10-day EMA of the advancers' share, advances / (advances + declines). Zweig's classic launch signal fires when it surges from below 0.40 (washed out) through 0.615 (thrust) inside 10 days — a rare, powerful 'everything's going up at once' kick-off. HONESTY: on our survivorship-biased S&P-500 proxy the strict crossing fires far more often than the canonical ~once-a-decade NYSE signal (rebuilt-from-survivors rebounds look broader than they were live), so read this as a momentum gauge, not the rare historic trigger.上涨家数占比（上涨 /(上涨+下跌)）的10日指数均线。兹威格的经典启动信号：在10日内自0.40以下（超卖）急升突破0.615（脉冲）时触发 —— 罕见而强劲的「同涨」启动。诚实说明：在带有幸存者偏差的标普500代理上，严格的穿越远比经典的纽交所「十年一遇」信号更频繁（以幸存者重建的反弹看起来比当时更广），故此处作为动量计读取，而非罕见的历史触发。

A/D line vs price腾落线对价格 ?Does the cumulative advance/decline line confirm the index's recent extremes? If price prints a fresh 3-month high the A/D line will NOT confirm, the advance is narrowing underneath (bearish divergence); a fresh price low the A/D line refuses to confirm is a bullish divergence. Otherwise the internals are confirming the move, or nothing is at an extreme (in range). The sparkline traces the A/D line; the correlation is price-vs-A/D over the last 60 sessions.累积腾落线是否确认指数近期的极值？若价格创3个月新高而腾落线未确认，则上涨在底层收窄（看跌背离）；若价格创新低而腾落线拒绝确认，则为看涨背离。否则即为内部结构确认走势，或均未触及极值（区间内）。曲线描绘腾落线；相关系数为近60个交易日价格与腾落线的相关性。

The primary sector timing engine: a confluence of MACD + StochRSI crossovers on the 3-day chart (the daily is the early trigger), gated by the 200-day trend and sorted most-actionable first. Validated 1998-2026 — the base-rate column is the MEASURED forward-63-day excess vs SPY for each state:

The OVERSOLD BOUNCE row's headline is its ABSOLUTE return (the dip bounces); its vs-SPY is shown beside it because a low-beta defensive tends to lag a rising index — a tactical mean-reversion trade, never a confirmed buy. Honest ceiling: hit-rates ~50-56% — the edge is in magnitude and in AVOIDANCE (it stops you chasing the "confirmed leadership" that institutions distribute into), not a high win-rate. Turn Setups — early bottoming signs by stock拐点形态 — 个股早期筑底迹象 ? A per-stock checklist of early bottoming signs — more filled boxes = more timeframes agreeing. Not a buy list and not a return forecast: in 26 past cases about 6 in 10 of these signs faded within a day. The four boxes: D = daily momentum turned up; 3D = the house 3-day entry signal; W = weekly (filled = confirmed, dashed = approaching); 2W = biweekly. TURNING UP = 3+ boxes filled including a weekly one · EARLY SIGN = 2 boxes. Monthly phase is anti-trap context only, not a gate. Updates after each nightly run. 个股早期筑底迹象检查表 — 实心格越多，代表越多时间框架同向。 非买入清单、非收益预测：历史26次中约六成迹象在一天内消退。 四个格子：D=日线动能转上；3D=本系统3日入场信号； W=周线（实心=确认，虚线=接近）；2W=双周线。 转强确认=3格以上且含周线级 · 初步迹象=2格。 月线阶段仅作防陷阱参考，非门控。 每晚更新。

Accumulation watch — sector ETFs增持监测 — 板块 ETF ?Each sector SPDR's top-10 holdings. Beyond price = the weight a stock gained above what its own price move explains — a sign real money flowed in, not just drift. Est. $ flow applies that to the fund's assets (approximate). ✅ = accumulation plus a forming buy setup. Caveat: these are passive index funds, so this is index-rebalancing flow, not a manager's conviction. Thresholds are still settling as daily snapshots build up.每只板块 SPDR 的前十大持仓。剔除价格后 = 个股权重增长中超出其自身价格涨幅所能解释的部分 — 代表确有真实资金流入，而非随行就市。估算资金流 = 该残差乘以基金资产（近似值）。✅ = 增持且出现正在形成的买入形态。提示：这些是被动指数基金，故此为指数再平衡资金流，而非主动经理的信念。随着每日快照积累，阈值仍在校准中。

Holdings gaining ETF weight faster than price alone explains — a heads-up on quiet accumulation, not a buy list.板块 ETF 中权重增长快于价格本身的持仓 — 悄然增持的提示信号，而非买入清单。
